name: Iris (RelayPay support)
firstMessage: Hi, I'm Iris from RelayPay support. How can I help you today?

analysisPlan.summaryPrompt: Summarise this RelayPay support call for the support team in two or three plain sentences: what the caller wanted, what Iris did (answers, lookups, tickets, escalations, with any IDs), and anything still open. Don't include email addresses or other contact details.
